Point on the x-axis equidistant from two points: Class 10 board exam ka ye coordinate geometry question dekh ke ghabrahat hoti hai? Trick: y = 0. Step by step, from the question to the answer.

• A point on the x-axis is P(x, 0)
• Equidistant means PA = PB, so square both sides: (x − 2)² + 5² = (x + 2)² + 9²
• Expand and cancel: −4x + 25 = 4x + 81, so −8x = 56 and x = −7
• The point is (−7, 0). Check: PA² = PB² = 9² + 5² = 106
